main_text.p: nos corrupto vocabulo Tamerlanem vo-camus, ex filio nepote, jam nimis anti-qvas esse, & ad hæc tempora non satis be-ne respondere: motus propterea Plane-tarum aliqva apud ipso indigere correc-tione, & alia qvamplurima desiderari ; qvapropter à me petiit ut Ephemerides aliqvas,& alios Libros ex nostris sibi mit-terem, qvos ut percipere posset,notas o-mes Arithmeticas, Characteres nostro Astronomicos, necnon Litteras Alpha-beti,ac modum legendi sedulo à me ad-discere voluit ; & si Ephemerides Ma-gini, qvas illi misi, ad ejus manus per-venerunt, non dubito ,qvin ex illis lum-mam delectatio nemac utilitatem sit per-ceptus. Hujus inqvam viri, apud qvem in Lar civitate, ipsius patria, aliqvot qvotidiana consvetudine familiarissime versatus, complu ta ab eodem didici scitu dignissima, Ephemerides habeo unius anni ad Meridianum ejusdem Civitatis Lar elaboratas, qvæ tamen qvia ille ad majora intentus, Ephemeridum Aucto-rem se profiteri dedignabatur, feruntur sub

page.notes: The last word of the page is a catchword "sub" (continues on the next page). Doubtful: "o-mes" at the line end, probably "omnes" as printed, transcribed as printed. "complu ta" shows a gap, probably "complura" or a spacing fault; kept as printed. Uncertain letters in the italic words "Tamerlanem", "Magini" and "Lar" are read from the scan. Faint marks at the right edge are the neighbouring page and are omitted.
